Child Education Plans

Invest in your child's future with secure education-focused insurance.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a child education plan?

A combination of life insurance and investment that provides guaranteed payouts at key education milestones (age 18, 21, 24) plus life cover for the parent. If parent passes away, future premiums are waived and payouts continue.

When should I start a child education plan?

As early as possible — ideally when the child is 0-5 years old. This maximizes the investment horizon and compounding, and premiums are lower. We can help calculate the target corpus based on current education costs and inflation.
